faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Counselor post is 17th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated office before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Counselor position?
faq.answer: Candidates should be graduates in Sociology or Psychology. A Master's degree in Social Work with 2 years of experience in family counseling is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Counselor recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Counselor position is between 35 years and 65 years, as of 16th September 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Counselor post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 24,000.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Counselor post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Counselor post in the Office of the Principal Judge (Family Court), Shravasti.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Counselor role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Application Scrutiny and Document Verification. Candidates will be shortlisted based on these stages.

faq.question: Q9. What type of job is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity for the Counselor position.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location is Shravasti, Uttar Pradesh.
